title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
keyIdea: Give fast a head start of n nodes, then move fast and slow together until fast is on the last node: slow is right before the node to remove. If fast became NULL after the head start, remove the head.

approaches.name: Count the length, then remove
approaches.idea: Pass 1 counts len. If n == len remove head; else walk prev to node len − n and skip the next node.

approaches.name: Two pointers, n apart
approaches.idea: fast moves n steps; fast == NULL → remove head; else move both until fast->next == NULL, then slow->next = slow->next->next.
approaches.why: One pass; the gap of n puts slow right before the target.

quiz.q: Why does slow end right before the node to remove?
options: fast stops on the last node and slow is n nodes behind it, so slow->next is n-th from the end

quiz.q: When does fast == NULL after the head start?
options: When n equals the length: the node to remove is the head

quiz.q: How would a dummy node before head help?
options: slow can start on the dummy, so removing the head needs no special case

quiz.q: Why loop while fast->next != NULL, not fast != NULL?
options: So fast stops ON the last node and slow stops BEFORE the target
